titles: The Simplest Pregnancy Book in the World
notes: Portrait, taken from the end of an aisle in a used bookshop: a long wall of wooden shelving on the left (fiction, religion, new age, parenting, with handwritten labels) receding at a steep angle, a health bookcase on the right seen more nearly straight-on, a wall with red and blue graffiti in the corner; even indoor light, in focus, no glare; very dense and most spines are small and oblique. English throughout. Titles from spines except The Reiki Manual, which stands face-out on the floor; multiple copies (Womancode, Healing PCOS) listed once. The same shop as the other photos in this batch with religion shelves. Left out: the great majority of spines, which are too small or too foreshortened to read at full resolution (the Bibles, the Buddhism, Christianity and new-age shelves, the far-left fiction, the health shelves except the face-out and larger spines), the cardboard box and pink sticky note at the bottom left, the loose papers standing on the shelves. Non-book items: handwritten shelf labels, a cardboard box, a sticky note, a printed sign about the Christian section. Drafted by claude-sonnet-5 (extraction 78), verified by an agent.
